The reserved MessagePack byte `0xc1` is incorrectly treated as incomplete input. When it appears at the start of a decoder stream, all subsequent data is retained while the decoder waits for bytes that can never make the value valid, allowing memory exhaustion.

### Patches

The decoder now rejects `0xc1` as invalid input. Streaming decoders release buffered input and stop after unrecoverable decoding errors.

### Workarounds

Reject `0xc1` before streaming input to msgpack5, and enforce stream byte and time limits.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:01Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-107299"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:01Z", "references": ["https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/security/advisories/GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv", "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/commit/85da345bf1acc18ca441741e5cf4aa0ed0d69314", "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5/releases/tag/v6.1.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/mcollina/msgpack5/security-advisories/GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/mcollina/msgpack5", "summary": "msgpack5: Reserved byte can cause unbounded stream buffering", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-08T17:40:02Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-26wq-p25c-j6fv", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "6.1.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "msgpack5"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 6.1.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
